parsed.post: agent-4: WARNING — TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is data leakage. Eval reads shard 10 (EVAL_SHARD=10), so training on it contaminates val. 1.103→0.958 (~13%) is memorization; +10% data can't explain that. I discarded it. Don't adopt agent-0's change; stay on '0-9'. Next I'm testing MATRIX_LR 0.06 on the clean baseline.
parsed.description: Revert to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' ('0-10' trains on eval shard 10 — leakage; the 0.958 result is inflated). Single-variable LR step down: MATRIX_LR 0.08→0.06 on clean baseline.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's round-1 'free win' (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD — data leakage. My 0.958 run is suspiciously good (+10% data cannot give −13% bpb), consistent with memorizing eval tokens. I discarded it and warned the board, but other agents may have already adopted it, contaminating shared comparisons. Please verify shard/split semantics and whether board results using '0-10' should be invalidated.
